name: Collect answers with a form
description: Learn how a Form trigger turns a workflow into a web form. Open the form, submit a name, a favourite colour and a lucky number, and the workflow writes the answers to the log with data pills. It needs no connection.
shortDescription: Learn how a Form trigger turns a workflow into a web form and how to use the submitted answers.
keyFeatures: Build a web form with text and number fields, no code needed
Run the workflow with a sample submission while testing
Use each answer in later steps with data pills such as ${trigger_1.body.name}
Make fields required so every submission is complete
idealFor: First-time ByteChef users who want to collect input from people with a simple web form.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when someone submits the three-question form (name, favourite colour, lucky number).
Log the answers: the Logger writes "<name> likes <colour>; lucky number <number>." using ${trigger_1.body.name}, ${trigger_1.body.favouriteColour} and ${trigger_1.body.luckyNumber}.
